Hi Sarah — great to hear, and thanks for the clear asks. I attached a concise MAP and an acceptance-test checklist below; summary here so you have a quick reference:

Summary of proposed MAP (attached: MedVantage_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): NDA + SOW draft (we provided SOW draft v0.1); basic account setup and token procurement.
- Week 1 (kickoff): Baseline data ingestion, sample prompt sets, run initial latency/throughput smoke tests on a 10k token workload.
- Week 2 (initial acceptance window): Run acceptance tests A1-A5 (see attachment). Exit gate: if P95 latency > 600ms on target hardware or clinical extraction F1 < 0.82, we pause and iterate.
- Week 4 (mid-eval go/no-go): Full evaluation across 50k tokens, stress tests for concurrency, and quality checkpoints (regression vs baseline). Exit gate: token cost per 1k below quoted threshold, and no critical security concerns unresolved.
- Week 6 (final decision): Consolidated acceptance report and recommended production model variant.

Acceptance tests (attached: medvantage_acceptance_tests.md) highlights:
- A1: P95 latency under 500ms for median prompt length (10-30 tokens) with concurrency of 8.
- A2: Clinical field extraction accuracy (entity-level F1) >= 0.85 on curated test set.
- A3: Redaction safety: automated redaction detects and removes direct PHI 100% of the time in seeded tests.
- A4: Consistency regression: no more than 5% drop vs baseline model on core KPI prompts.
- A5: Throughput stability: 24-hour run with <0.5% error rate.

Security artifacts we will share: SOC2 summary, data retention policy, and logs sampling guide. Please expect the SOW draft and MAP as attachments in this thread (I attached MedVantage_MAP_v1.xlsx and medvantage_acceptance_tests.md; SOW draft attached as sow-draft.pdf).

If this aligns, I can loop in Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (solutions) for technical runbook alignment and to set the exact dates for the stage gates.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
